description:
Bridge ACTION lines in notes and logs into anchored TASK lines, and mutate those anchors.

Top-level (no subcommand): scans notes/ and logs/, validates every ACTION line, and rewrites it in place as a TASK anchor with a fresh 8-char uuid.
  [] [--dry-run] [--quiet] — run the ingest pass

Subcommands:
  add THREAD TEXT [--due YYYY-MM-DD] [--scheduled YYYY-MM-DD] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID8] — buffer-append a structured ACTION (delegates to `buffer add-action`)
  done UUID — mark complete; rewrites source TASK to DONE and stamps end with today
  set-description UUID TEXT — rewrite the body
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — rewrite the (Assignee) prefix
  set-due UUID DATE — set due date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set scheduled date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set priority H, M, or L; written as [#X] in the visible portion
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — add a depends entry
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove a depends entry
  list [--priority H|M|L] [--thread T] [--assignee A] [--overdue] — list pending tasks
  next — top 5 pending tasks by priority, due, entry
  show UUID — detail view of one anchor

Flags:
  top level: --dry-run show what would be ingested without writing; --quiet suppress per-action output. Both apply only to the no-subcommand invocation.
  add: --due YYYY-MM-DD; --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD; --priority one of H, M, L; --depends 8-char uuid prefix, repeatable.
  list: --priority one of H, M, L; --thread thread label such as Processes/SGB, matched against the source note's thread; --assignee person name; --overdue only tasks due before today.

Examples:
  ["--dry-run"]
  ["add", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Send quarterly report", "--due", "2026-06-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["list", "--overdue", "--priority", "H"]
  ["set-due", "abcd1234", "2026-06-15"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]

Notes:
  UUID arguments accept a prefix; an ambiguous prefix exits 1.
  `add` only stages an ACTION in the buffer. It becomes a task after `buffer flush` and a subsequent `tasks` ingest pass.
  All mutating subcommands rewrite the source note or log line in place; source files are the only store.
  Exit 1 on: no task matching the uuid prefix, ambiguous prefix, empty description, assignee not resolving to a people file, or a task depending on itself.
